This channel provides clear, evidence-informed education on pain, rehabilitation, movement, and exercise.

Led by Joseley Thomasraj, a licensed physiotherapist with a Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in Physiotherapy, over 20 years of clinical and teaching experience, and published research in the field. He currently practices in Canada.

Videos are designed for both patients and healthcare professionals, translating current research and clinical experience into practical, easy-to-understand guidance.

Topics include:
• Pain science and recovery
• Exercise therapy and movement education
• Strength, mobility, and balance
• Injury prevention and long-term function
• Rehabilitation across the lifespan

Disclaimer: Content is for educational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a licensed healthcare provider before attempting any exercises or interventions. Use at your own risk.
